title: Asian Games: PH qualifies to 4x400m mixed relay final, breaks PH record
summary: Team Philippines booked a spot in the 4x400 meter mixed relay final of the athletics event at the 20th Asian Games on Thursday morning at the Nagoya City Mizuho Park Athletic Stadium.
